# Aura Dark

Aura Dark is a dark theme published in two variants, Aura Dark and Aura Dark Soft, the second carrying softer text styling for gentler contrast. Its recorded description also claims coverage of the whole interface and an optional light mode.

![Aura Dark screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/possibly-not/obsidian-aura-theme/HEAD/img/aura_dark_diagonal.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Aura Dark"
    author: "possibly-not"
    repo:   "possibly-not/obsidian-aura-theme"
    slug:   "aura-dark"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/aura-dark"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/possibly-not/obsidian-aura-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/possibly-not/obsidian-aura-theme/HEAD/img/aura_dark_diagonal.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a refined dark theme to Obsidian with two variants: Aura Dark and Aura Dark Soft. Enjoy complete UI coverage, optional light mode, and softer text styling for gentler contrast."
}
```
